source.label: Bob's Guide to Classic Pinball Machines

strategy.summary: Collect A through F to light 5X Bonus, then repeat the safer saucer as its value rises to 10,000. Use each saucer's first kickout to decide which side to repeat.

steps.text: Plunge A or B. On later balls, plunge the top lane that is still missing.
Hit the C, D, E, and F standup targets. C-D lights 2X Bonus, C-D-E-F lights 3X, and all six letters light 5X.
Shoot either saucer. Its value advances through 1,000, 2,000, 4,000, 6,000, 8,000, and 10,000.
Repeat the saucer whose kickout can be controlled. Keep the 5X end-of-ball bonus intact by avoiding a tilt.

cautions.issue: The two saucers can have different kickout feeds.
cautions.response: Test each natural collect and repeat only the saucer whose eject can be caught or safely transferred.

strategy.simpleOverview: In Lost World, completing A through F lights 2X, 3X, and 5X Bonus. Repeated shots raise only the saucer being hit, up to 10,000, so test the first kickout from both saucers and repeat the side with the safer return.
strategy.overview: Completing A through F lights 5X Bonus in Lost World, while repeated shots raise each saucer's value to 10,000. Plunge a missing top letter, finish the C-F standups, then test both saucer kickouts. Repeat the safer saucer and preserve the multiplied end-of-ball bonus by avoiding a tilt.
